To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the general QCD parametrizations of hadron properties, derived exactly from QCD with three colors, are in good agreement with experiment, and that the 1/N(c) expansion, which has been widely used in the literature, is not reliable.

(i) a large N(c) calculation can be used to obtain the hadron properties in the real 3-color QCD, if the large N(c)-limit is taken in a particular way, and (ii) the general QCD parametrized calculation is more accurate and can be used for a wide range of N(c) values, while the large N(c )-limit is valid only for N(c) >> 3.
the 1/Nc expansion is a useful approximation of the QCD Lagrangian, but that it is not a complete description of the physics.
